branded.why: A one-off or short-lived product that left no mark on how people eat.

about.text: An industrial cylindrical soft cheese with a bloomy rind, about 2 kg, made from pasteurised cow's milk in the Aisne department from 1973 by the Bongrain group. It is ripened about ten days, and production is said to have stopped in the 1990s.

sources.text: Pasteurised milk, the ten-day ripening, the bloomy rind, Aisne, 1973 and Bongrain.
